items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was an Adam Powell Sr. (chuckles), contrary to popular opinion, Adam Powell Jr. just didn't, didn't come on the scene, and my mother was very much involved in that area.

ctx.x: Carter G. Woodson. Carter G. Woodson was one of the great ones. And of course … I know that, as I said, W.E.B. DuBois who had the crisis and so forth … uh … there was an Adam Powell Sr. (chuckles), contrary to popular opinion, Adam Powell Jr. just didn't, didn't come on the scene, and my mother was very much involved in that area. Who are the other people. There were other people involved. You know when you're a kid, you sometimes don't, it's only in retrospect that you kind of remember the people were that who…
Getting back to your earliest musical memories. When did you first start hearing this music and when did you first start noticing this was jazz; what kind of effect did it have on you?
